name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 132 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 132 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting a UN warning of ethnic cleansing. Israeli raids across the West Bank injured Palestinians and led to arrests, while settlers assaulted activists and journalists in the occupied territory. Israel banned travel for Brad Lander after his detention in the West Bank and Jewish Israeli blocs rejected Palestinian support. In Gaza, Israeli strikes this week killed 21 people, an aid group reported worsening food insecurity as operations were sharply cut, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker intensiverte en nedslagning i Hebron, fordrevet tusenvis og førte til en FN-advarsel om etnisk rensing. Israelske raid over hele Vestbredden såret palestinere og førte til arrestasjoner, mens bosettere angrep aktivister og journalister i det okkuperte området. Israel forbød reise for Brad Lander etter hans varetektsfengsling på Vestbredden, og jødiske israelske blokker avviste palestinsk støtte. I Gaza drepte israelske angrep denne uken 21 personer, en hjelpeorganisasjon rapporterte forverret matusikkerhet etter at operasjonene ble kraftig kuttet, og 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
